import json,hashlib,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
R=Path('plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification/reports/phase-06')
pack=R/'review-pack-261015-0236-bounded-corrections.md'; side=Path(str(pack)+'.json')
h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b if isinstance(b,bytes) else b.encode()).hexdigest()
git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a])
d=json.loads(side.read_text()); v=json.loads((R/'root-boundary-native-verification.json').read_text()); rows=d['rows']; text=pack.read_text()
assert h(pack.read_bytes())==d['packSHA256']; assert len(rows)==44 and len({x['id'] for x in rows})==44
expected={(x['file'],x['entryKind'],x['claimId']) for x in v['nativeProofResume']['changedAtInputCommit']['reReviewRows']}
actual={(x['shard'],x['entryKind'],x['claimId']) for x in rows[:33]}
assert expected==actual and len(actual)==33
assert {x['reportID'] for x in v['fileEditsResume']['reworkVerdicts']} <= {x['claimId'] for x in rows[:33]}
retained={(x['file'],x['entryKind'],x['claimId']) for x in v['nativeProofResume']['changedAtInputCommit']['allChangedRows'] if not x['reReview']}
assert retained.isdisjoint(actual)
for x in rows:
 assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',x['sourceDigest'])
 assert x['targetDigest'] is None or re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',x['targetDigest'])
 assert x['answers']['reportPath'] and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',x['answers']['reportCommit'])
 git('cat-file','-e',x['answers']['reportCommit']+':'+x['answers']['reportPath'])
 for k in ['source','target','beforeTarget','currentSource']:
  w=x.get(k)
  if not w:continue
  assert h(w['text'])==w['shownTextSHA256'] and w['text'] in text
  assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',w['contentCommit'])
  b=git('show',w['contentCommit']+':'+w['path'])
  if 'fileSHA256' in w:assert h(b)==w['fileSHA256']
  if k=='target':assert w['contentCommit'] in [d['contentCommit'],d['proofCommit']]
 for c in x.get('fileChecks',[]):
  assert c['corpus']=='user-knowledge' and c['authorityStatus']=='non-authority' and c['targetOwner'] is None
  assert c['inShardSources'] and c['disposition']=='reclassify-out-of-platform-scope'
  for k in ['before','after']:
   w=c[k];assert w['text'] in text and h(w['text'])==w['SHA256'];assert git('show',w['contentCommit']+':'+c['path']).decode()==w['text']
assert d['differingDigestRows']==[x['id'] for x in rows if x['sourceDigest']!=x['targetDigest']]
assert len(d['differingDigestRows'])==37
assert d['absentTargetRows']==['claim_2ae81c7bed935553943d6777b81e2114']
listrow=rows[-2]; b=json.loads(listrow['source']['text']);a=json.loads(listrow['target']['text']);assert b['count']==len(b['rows'])==832 and a['count']==len(a['rows'])==830
tupleof=lambda x:(x['claimId'],x['path'],x['anchor'],x['unitDigest'],x['status'])
bs={tupleof(x) for x in b['rows']};as_={tupleof(x) for x in a['rows']}
assert len(bs)==832 and len(as_)==830 and not as_-bs
assert bs-as_=={tupleof(x) for x in listrow['delta']['removed']}
assert len(rows[-1]['fileChecks'])==21 and len(d['differingFileChecks'])==21
for x in rows[:33]:
 shard=json.loads(git('show',d['contentCommit']+':'+x['shard']))
 exact=next(a for a in shard[x['entryKind']] if a['claimId']==x['claimId'])
 assert exact==x['decision'] and exact['reviewStatus']=='pending'
 for f in ['reviewedBy','reviewedAt','reviewReport','reviewReportCommit'] :assert f not in exact
assert git('merge-base','--is-ancestor',d['contentCommit'],d['proofCommit'])==b''
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()==d['proofCommit']
